verses.en: And he made the altar of burnt offering of shittim wood: five cubits was the length thereof, and five cubits the breadth thereof; it was foursquare; and three cubits the height thereof.
verses.pt: Fez também o altar do holocausto de madeira de acácia; de cinco côvados era o seu comprimento e de cinco côvados a sua largura, quadrado, e de três côvados a sua altura.
verses.en_web: He made the altar of burnt offering of acacia wood. It was square. Its length was five cubits, its width was five cubits, and its height was three cubits.
verses.en_bbe: The altar of burned offerings he made of hard wood; a square altar, five cubits long, five cubits wide and three cubits high,

verses.en: And he made the horns thereof on the four corners of it; the horns thereof were of the same: and he overlaid it with brass.
verses.pt: E fez-lhe pontas nos seus quatro cantos; as suas pontas formavam uma só peça com ele; e cobriu-o de bronze.
verses.en_web: He made its horns on its four corners. Its horns were of one piece with it, and he overlaid it with brass.
verses.en_bbe: And he put horns at its four angles made of the same, plating it all with brass;

verses.en: And he made all the vessels of the altar, the pots, and the shovels, and the basons, and the fleshhooks, and the firepans: all the vessels thereof made he of brass.
verses.pt: Fez também todos os utensílios do altar: os cinzeiros, as pás, as bacias, os garfos e os braseiros; todos os seus utensílios fez de bronze.
verses.en_web: He made all the vessels of the altar, the pots, the shovels, the basins, the forks, and the fire pans. He made all its vessels of brass.
verses.en_bbe: And brass was used for all the vessels of the altar, the baskets and the spades, the basins and the meat-hooks and the fire-trays; all the vessels he made of brass

verses.en: And he made for the altar a brasen grate of network under the compass thereof beneath unto the midst of it.
verses.pt: Fez também para o altar um crivo de bronze em forma de rede, em baixo da borda ao redor, chegando ele até o meio do altar.
verses.en_web: He made for the altar a grating of a network of brass, under the ledge around it beneath, reaching halfway up.
verses.en_bbe: And he made a network of brass for the altar, under the frame round it, stretching half-way up;

verses.en: And he cast four rings for the four ends of the grate of brass, to be places for the staves.
verses.pt: E fundiu quatro argolas para as quatro extremidades do crivo de bronze, como lugares dos varais.
verses.en_web: He cast four rings for the four ends of brass grating, to be places for the poles.
verses.en_bbe: And four rings for the four angles of this network, to take the rods.

verses.en: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with brass.
verses.pt: E fez os varais de madeira de acácia, e os cobriu de bronze.
verses.en_web: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with brass.
verses.en_bbe: The rods he made of hard wood plated with brass.

verses.en: And he put the staves into the rings on the sides of the altar, to bear it withal; he made the altar hollow with boards.
verses.pt: E meteu os varais pelas argolas aos lados do altar, para com eles se levar o altar; fê-lo oco, de tábuas.
verses.en_web: He put the poles into the rings on the sides of the altar, with which to carry it. He made it hollow with planks.
verses.en_bbe: He put the rods through the rings at the opposite sides of the altar for lifting it; he made the altar hollow, boarded in with wood.

verses.en: And he made the laver of brass, and the foot of it of brass, of the lookingglasses of the women assembling, which assembled at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.pt: Fez também a pia de bronze com a sua base de bronze, dos espelhos das mulheres que se reuniam e ministravam à porta da tenda da revelação.
verses.en_web: He made the basin of brass, and its base of brass, out of the mirrors of the ministering women who ministered at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
verses.en_bbe: And he made the washing-vessel of brass on a brass base, using the polished brass looking-glasses given by the women who did work at the doors of the Tent of meeting.

verses.en: And he made the court: on the south side southward the hangings of the court were of fine twined linen, an hundred cubits:
verses.pt: Fez também o átrio. Para o lado meridional as cortinas eram de linho fino torcido, de cem côvados de comprimento.
verses.en_web: He made the court: for the south side southward the hangings of the court were of fine twined linen, one hundred cubits;
verses.en_bbe: To make the open space, he put hangings on the south side, of the best linen, a hundred cubits long:

verses.en: Their pillars were twenty, and their brasen sockets twenty; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver.
verses.pt: As suas colunas eram vinte, e vinte as suas bases, todas de bronze; os colchetes das colunas e as suas faixas eram de prata.
verses.en_web: their pillars were twenty, and their sockets twenty, of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver.
verses.en_bbe: Their twenty pillars and their twenty bases were brass; and the hooks of the pillars and their bands were of silver.

verses.en: And for the north side the hangings were an hundred cubits, their pillars were twenty, and their sockets of brass twenty; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.
verses.pt: Para o lado setentrional as cortinas eram de cem côvados; as suas colunas eram vinte, e vinte as suas bases, todas de bronze; os colchetes das colunas e as suas faixas eram de prata.
verses.en_web: For the north side one hundred cubits, their pillars twenty, and their sockets twenty, of brass; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.
verses.en_bbe: And for the north side. hangings a hundred cubits long, on twenty brass pillars in brass bases, with silver hooks and bands.

verses.en: And for the west side were hangings of fifty cubits, their pillars ten, and their sockets ten; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.
verses.pt: Para o lado ocidental as cortinas eram de cinquenta covados; as suas colunas eram dez, e as suas bases dez; os colchetes das colunas e as suas faixas eram de prata.
verses.en_web: For the west side were hangings of fifty cubits, their pillars ten, and their sockets ten; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.
verses.en_bbe: And on the west side, hangings fifty cubits long, on ten pillars in ten bases, with silver bands.

verses.en: And for the east side eastward fifty cubits.
verses.pt: E para o lado oriental eram as cortinas de cinqüenta côvados.
verses.en_web: For the east side eastward fifty cubits.
verses.en_bbe: And on the east side, the open space was fifty cubits long.

verses.en: The hangings of the one side of the gate were fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
verses.pt: As cortinas para um lado da porta eram de quinze côvados; as suas colunas eram três e as suas bases três.
verses.en_web: The hangings for the one side were fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three;
verses.en_bbe: The hangings on one side of the doorway were fifteen cubits long, on three pillars with their three bases;

verses.en: And for the other side of the court gate, on this hand and that hand, were hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
verses.pt: Do mesmo modo para o outro lado; de um e de outro lado da porta do átrio havia cortinas de quinze côvados; as suas colunas eram três e as suas bases três.
verses.en_web: and so for the other side: on this hand and that hand by the gate of the court were hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
verses.en_bbe: And the same on the other side of the doorway; on this side and on that the hangings were fifteen cubits long, on three pillars with their three bases.

verses.en: All the hangings of the court round about were of fine twined linen.
verses.pt: Todas as cortinas do átrio ao redor eram de linho fino torcido.
verses.en_web: All the hangings around the court were of fine twined linen.
verses.en_bbe: All the hangings were of the best linen.

verses.en: And the sockets for the pillars were of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver; and the overlaying of their chapiters of silver; and all the pillars of the court were filleted with silver.
verses.pt: As bases das colunas eram de bronze; os colchetes das colunas e as suas faixas eram de prata; o revestimento dos seus capitéis era de prata; e todas as colunas do átrio eram cingidas de faixas de prata.
verses.en_web: The sockets for the pillars were of brass. The hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver; and the overlaying of their capitals, of silver; and all the pillars of the court were filleted with silver.
verses.en_bbe: And the bases of the pillars were of brass; their hooks and the bands round the tops of them were of silver; all the pillars were ringed with silver.

verses.en: And the hanging for the gate of the court was needlework, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen: and twenty cubits was the length, and the height in the breadth was five cubits, answerable to the hangings of the court.
verses.pt: O reposteiro da porta do átrio era de azul, púrpura, carmesim e linho fino torcido, obra de bordador; o comprimento era de vinte côvados, e a altura, na largura, de cinco côvados, conforme a altura das cortinas do átrio.
verses.en_web: The screen for the gate of the court was the work of the embroiderer, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen. Twenty cubits was the length, and the height in the width was five cubits, like to the hangings of the court.
verses.en_bbe: And the curtain for the doorway of the open space was of the best linen, with designs of blue and purple and red in needlework; it was twenty cubits long and five cubits high, to go with the hangings round the sides.

verses.en: And their pillars were four, and their sockets of brass four; their hooks of silver, and the overlaying of their chapiters and their fillets of silver.
verses.pt: As suas colunas eram quatro, e quatro as suas bases, todas de bronze; os seus colchetes eram de prata, como também o revestimento dos capitéis, e as suas faixas.
verses.en_web: Their pillars were four, and their sockets four, of brass; their hooks of silver, and the overlaying of their capitals, and their fillets, of silver.
verses.en_bbe: There were four pillars with their bases, all of brass, the hooks being of silver, and their tops and their bands being covered with silver.

verses.en: And all the pins of the tabernacle, and of the court round about, were of brass.
verses.pt: E todas as estacas do tabernáculo e do átrio ao redor eram de bronze.
verses.en_web: All the pins of the tabernacle, and around the court, were of brass.
verses.en_bbe: All the nails used for the House and the open space round it were of brass.

verses.en: This is the sum of the tabernacle, even of the tabernacle of testimony, as it was counted, according to the commandment of Moses, for the service of the Levites, by the hand of Ithamar, son to Aaron the priest.
verses.pt: Esta é a enumeração das coisas para o tabernáculo, a saber, o tabernáculo do testemunho, que por ordem de Moisés foram contadas para o ministério dos levitas, por intermédio de Itamar, filho de Arão, o sacerdote.
verses.en_web: This is the amount of material used for the tabernacle, even the Tabernacle of the Testimony, as they were counted, according to the commandment of Moses, for the service of the Levites, by the hand of Ithamar, the son of Aaron the priest.
verses.en_bbe: This is the price of the making of the House, even the House of witness, as it was valued by the word of Moses, for the work of the Levites under the direction of Ithamar, the son of Aaron the priest.

verses.en: And Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.pt: Fez, pois, Bezaleel, filho de îri, filho de Hur, da tribo de Judá, tudo quanto o Senhor tinha ordenado a Moisés;
verses.en_web: Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that Yahweh commanded Moses.
verses.en_bbe: Bezalel, the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made everything as the Lord had given orders to Moses.

verses.en: And with him was Aholiab, son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver, and a cunning workman, and an embroiderer in blue, and in purple, and in scarlet, and fine linen.
verses.pt: e com ele Aoliabe, filho de Aisamaque, da tribo de Dã, gravador, desenhista, e bordador em azul, púrpura, carmesim e linho fino.
verses.en_web: With him was Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver, and a skillful workman, and an embroiderer in blue, in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen.
verses.en_bbe: And with him was Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan; a designer and a trained workman, expert in needlework of blue and purple and red and the best linen.

verses.en: All the gold that was occupied for the work in all the work of the holy place, even the gold of the offering, was twenty and nine talents, and seven hundred and thirty shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary.
verses.pt: Todo o ouro gasto na obra, em toda a obra do santuário, a saber, o ouro da oferta, foi vinte e nove talentos e setecentos e trinta siclos, conforme o siclo do santuário.
verses.en_web: All the gold that was used for the work in all the work of the sanctuary, even the gold of the offering, was twenty-nine talents, and seven hundred thirty shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary.
verses.en_bbe: The gold used for all the different work done for the holy place, the gold which was given, was twenty-nine talents, and seven hundred and thirty shekels in weight, by the scale of the holy place.

verses.en: And the silver of them that were numbered of the congregation was an hundred talents, and a thousand seven hundred and threescore and fifteen shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:
verses.pt: A prata dos arrolados da congregação montou em cem talentos e mil setecentos setenta e cinco siclos, conforme o siclo do santuário;
verses.en_web: The silver of those who were counted of the congregation was one hundred talents, and one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:
verses.en_bbe: And the silver given by those who were numbered of the people was a hundred talents, and a thousand, seven hundred and seventy-five shekels in weight, by the scale of the holy place.

verses.en: A bekah for every man, that is, half a shekel, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for every one that went to be numbered, from twenty years old and upward, for six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty men.
verses.pt: um beca para cada cabeça, isto é, meio siclo, conforme o siclo do santuário, de todo aquele que passava para os arrolados, da idade de vinte anos e acima, que foram seiscentos e três mil quinhentos e cinqüenta.
verses.en_web: a beka a head, that is, half a shekel, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for everyone who passed over to those who were counted, from twenty years old and upward, for six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty men.
verses.en_bbe: A beka, that is, half a shekel by the holy scale, for everyone who was numbered; there were six hundred and three thousand, five hundred and fifty men of twenty years old and over.

verses.en: And of the hundred talents of silver were cast the sockets of the sanctuary, and the sockets of the vail; an hundred sockets of the hundred talents, a talent for a socket.
verses.pt: E houve cem talentos de prata para fundir as bases do santuário e as bases do véu; para cem bases eram cem talentos, um talento para cada base.
verses.en_web: The one hundred talents of silver were for casting the sockets of the sanctuary, and the sockets of the veil; one hundred sockets for the one hundred talents, a talent for a socket.
verses.en_bbe: Of this silver, a hundred talents was used for making the bases of the pillars of the holy place and of the veil; a talent for every base.

verses.en: And of the thousand seven hundred seventy and five shekels he made hooks for the pillars, and overlaid their chapiters, and filleted them.
verses.pt: Mas dos mil setecentos e setenta e cinco siclos, fez colchetes para as colunas, e cobriu os seus capitéis e fez-lhes as faixas.
verses.en_web: Of the one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels he made hooks for the pillars, overlaid their capitals, and made fillets for them.
verses.en_bbe: And a thousand, seven hundred and seventy-five shekels of silver was used to make the hooks for the pillars, and for plating the tops of the pillars and for making their bands.

verses.en: And the brass of the offering was seventy talents, and two thousand and four hundred shekels.
verses.pt: E o bronze da oferta foi setenta talentos e dois mil e quatrocentos siclos.
verses.en_web: The brass of the offering was seventy talents, and two thousand four hundred shekels.
verses.en_bbe: The brass which was given was seventy talents, two thousand four hundred shekels;

verses.en: And therewith he made the sockets to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the brasen altar, and the brasen grate for it, and all the vessels of the altar,
verses.pt: Dele fez as bases da porta da tenda da revelação, o altar de bronze, e o crivo de bronze para ele, todos os utensílios do altar,
verses.en_web: With this he made the sockets to the door of the Tent of Meeting, the bronze altar, the bronze grating for it, all the vessels of the altar,
verses.en_bbe: From it he made the bases of the doorway of the Tent of meeting and the brass altar and the network for it and all the vessels for the altar,

verses.en: And the sockets of the court round about, and the sockets of the court gate, and all the pins of the tabernacle, and all the pins of the court round about.
verses.pt: as bases do átrio ao redor e as bases da porta do átrio, todas as estacas do tabernáculo e todas as estacas do átrio ao redor.
verses.en_web: the sockets around the court, the sockets of the gate of the court, all the pins of the tabernacle, and all the pins around the court.
verses.en_bbe: And the bases for the open space all round and for its doorway, and all the nails for the House and for the open space.
